deals.headline: Christian Bragarnik's group buys José Sepulcre's 70% of Elche
deals.summary: Europa Press (via Superdeporte) reported the sale of Sepulcre's 70% majority package to the investor group led by Bragarnik at around EUR 20m, citing local media. The club's own accounts describe control of 58.57% acquired by Score Club in 2019; AS (June 2026) says the price later rose to EUR 30m once the club won promotion.

deals.source_name: Elche C.F., S.A.D. annual accounts and management report, year to 30 June 2025 (note 8.2)
deals.summary: Elche and several other LaLiga clubs assigned the credit rights from their centrally sold audiovisual rights to Right and Media Funding Limited; Elche's price was EUR 10m, a five-year loan at a 5.64% effective rate repaid by LaLiga withholdings, almost fully repaid by 30 June 2025.

deals.headline: Elche's EUR 28.9m allocation from LaLiga Impulso (CVC)
deals.source_name: Elche C.F., S.A.D. annual accounts and management report, year to 30 June 2025 (note 8.2)
deals.summary: Under the LaLiga Impulso plan funded by CVC, Elche was allocated EUR 28,902,836 of participative loans repayable by 2071/72, with interest equal to 1.52% of its LaLiga audiovisual income; 70% must go to infrastructure. By 30 June 2025 only part had been drawn.

deals.summary: Palco23 reports that former president José Sepulcre gained majority control of Elche by capitalising loans and injecting resources of EUR 24.5m before selling to Bragarnik's group.

name: Elche Club de Fútbol, S.A.D.
notes: Latest accounts are 2024-25 (year to 30 June 2025), a Segunda División season; Elche were promoted for 2025-26. Revenue is net turnover (importe neto de la cifra de negocios); other operating income of EUR 5,510,120 and player-trading gains are outside it. The 2025/26 budget in the same PDF projects net turnover of EUR 58.343m (thousand-euro table), which is a budget, not an outturn. Breakdown: matchday is not stated as one figure (league gate 1,091,998; cup gate 890,380; friendlies 13,555; season tickets 2,653,795, all EUR); commercial = 'publicidad y comercialización' only (shop sales 779,358 and leasing 312,719 are separate lines). All accounts figures are in the PDF linked from the club's transparency page. Stake history conflicts: press in Dec 2019 reported 70% bought from Sepulcre; the accounts say control of 58.57% was acquired in 2019, now 97.54% after capital increases (AS says Score Club holds 99%). The shirt sponsor was Vegafibra in 2025-26 and is Flexicar from August 2026. No valuation, social-follower count, attendance figure or net debt was found on a citable page. The old record's capacity (33,732, from a stadium-list site) is replaced by the club's own 31,388.

owners.name: Christian Bragarnik (via Score Club 2019, S.L.)

ownership_summary: Elche Club de Fútbol, S.A.D. is 97.54% owned by Score Club 2019, S.L., the vehicle led by Argentine football agent and businessman Christian Bragarnik, whose group bought former president José Sepulcre's controlling stake in December 2019; the club's accounts say Score Club took control of 58.57% in 2019 and reached 97.54% through later capital increases. AS reports that other businessmen and players (such as Darío Benedetto) sit in Score Club with him. No institutional investor holds equity; the club's institutional money is debt-like (LaLiga Impulso/CVC participative loans and a 2020 assignment of TV receivables).
